errors.network_error_apprise: Apprise URL {{line}} ({{url}}): the service could not be reached.
errors.rate_limited_apprise: Apprise URL {{line}} ({{url}}): the service asked to slow down (HTTP 429). Try again later.
errors.service_error_apprise: Apprise URL {{line}} ({{url}}): the service answered with HTTP error {{status}}.
errors.service_rejected_apprise: Apprise URL {{line}} ({{url}}): the service refused the notification (HTTP {{status}}). Check the token or the address.
errors.send_failed_apprise: Apprise URL {{line}} ({{url}}): Apprise could not send the notification.

notifications.appriseHelp: Send notifications to ntfy, Telegram, Discord, Home Assistant and many other services through Apprise URLs. Not the Apprise fanout integration: this one carries the system notifications chosen in the table below.
notifications.appriseUrlsHelp: Examples: ntfys://ntfy.sh/my-topic, tgram://bot_token/chat_id, discord://webhook_id/webhook_token, hassios://homeassistant.local:8123/token. The URLs hold tokens: they are never shown again after saving.
notifications.appriseUrlsKept: The saved URLs are hidden (********). Replace them to change them, or empty the field to remove them.
notifications.apprisePrivacy: Private messages and private channels are sent as a title only ("Message from Léa") unless you choose Always. The services you send to (ntfy.sh, Telegram, Discord…) receive and may keep what you send: you are responsible for forwarding other people's messages.
notifications.appriseAllowPrivate: Allow a destination on a private network (LAN, localhost)
notifications.appriseAllowPrivateHelp: Off by default. Turn it on for an ntfy, Gotify or Home Assistant server on your network or on this machine. Cloud metadata addresses are always refused.
